rows.traditional: 搞到 A 一頭霧水
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2
rows.note: Use this when a complicated or unexpected situation leaves someone baffled, rather than when two things are mixed up.

example.english: This complicated situation serves to confuse me.
example.traditional: 呢件事搞到我一頭霧水。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when someone mixes up or mistakes one person or thing for another.

example.english: You always confuse me with my younger brother—I’m the older brother.
example.traditional: 你成日搞亂我同我細佬，我先係哥哥呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 sing4 jat6 gaau2 lyun6 ngo5 tung4 ngo5 sai3 lou2 ngo5 sin1 hai6 go1 go1 aa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for saying that you cannot understand or sort something out.

example.english: I can't figure out why this happened; it continues to confuse me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau2 m4 cing1 co2 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2
